items.quote: I negotiated my rent down by 5%. But honestly, the discount was expected…
items.statement: I negotiated my rent down by 5%.

items.quote: …the most interesting part was what rental agent Told me - over past 2 months he closed 1 rental deal 20% below market.
items.statement: Over the past 2 months, rental agents closed deals 20% below market.

items.quote: I can’t see any movements in a price. But what I see a lot here - is that Agencies CEO’s complains a lot about the marketing cost - while the leads numbers dropped 3-4 times…
items.statement: Rental agencies' CEO's complain about marketing costs while leads have dropped.

items.quote: Landlords still want yesterday’s prices. Sellers still expect last year’s demand.
items.statement: Landlords expect outdated prices despite changes in demand.

items.quote: The bigger problem is how quickly companies adjust their sales process, pricing conversations, agent training and lead conversion strategy to the new market reality.
items.statement: Agencies adjusting sales processes based on new market realities.

items.quote: Many off-plan focused agencies stoped the marketing completely or narrowed down to GCC I would consider it a White Flag…
items.statement: Some agencies have stopped or narrowed their marketing efforts.

items.quote: The companies I work with are still running Marketing campaigns and generating leads.
items.statement: Companies are still running marketing campaigns and generating leads.

items.quote: They are tightening performance, improving client conversations, training agents properly and becoming much more selective with where they spend their money.
items.statement: Agents are tightening performance and improving client conversations.

items.quote: So I am genuinely curious. What is happening in your company right now? Are you still getting quality leads?
items.statement: Inquiring about quality leads in companies.

items.quote: Are you able to successfully negotiate Price Reduction?
items.statement: Questioning ability to negotiate price reduction.

overview: LinkedIn post discussing real estate market dynamics and negotiation experiences.
